title: MothOut Wardrobe & Carpet Moth Killer Spray, Kills Moths all Species, Adults, Larvae & Pupae, Non-Staining, Low Odour, Moth Repellent for Carpets, Curtains, Hard Surfaces & Cushions (500 Millilitres)
bullet_points: KILLS ON CONTACT AND DETERS MOTHS AT ALL LIFE STAGES - MothOut Moth Killer Spray is expertly formulated to target and eradicate moths at all life stages including larvae, pupae, and adults. Main targets are the three most textile damaging moths: Common Webbing Moths, Case-Bearing Carpet Moths, and Pale-Backed Moths, which are responsible for most fabric damage. Rarely but as damaging moths such as Brown house moths or White-shouldered moths will also be eliminated. MothOut spray ensures a thorough approach to moth control, preventing reinfestation and safeguarding your home from future infestations.

VERSITILE USAGE - Designed for use in various settings, MothOut is suitable for application on hard non-porous surfaces, cracks, crevices, and soft furnishings like mattresses and carpets. Thanks to its flexible nozzle and fine mist technology, the spray can also be effectively used to treat infested spaces with precision and ease forming an invisible barrier that repels and kills moths. It's ideal for domestic spaces and public hygiene areas such as hospitals, offices, museums, public transport, hotels and more.

LOW ODOUR AND NON-STAINING - MothOut Moth Killer Spray features a water-based, solvent-free formula that ensures minimal odour during and after use, leaves no stains or sticky residue and is gentle on all fabrics and surfaces, helping preserve the original look and feel of carpets, rugs, curtains, and upholstery. Unlike many insecticidal sprays or moth bombs it avoids the harsh chemical smell, making it a more pleasant choice for regular use in living areas.

LONG-LASTING & READY TO USE - MothOut delivers powerful, long-lasting protection against moths and other pests with a strong residual effect that reduces the need for frequent reapplication. Its full-strength, ready-to-use formula requires no dilution or mixing, offering quick and efficient pest control. Designed for both amateur and professional use, MothOut ensures convenient application and lasting results with every spray.

EXPERT GUIDANCE INCLUDED - Every purchase of MothOut Moth Killer Spray includes a comprehensive digital eBook sent via email. This expert-written guide explains moth behaviour, key species, and how to effectively identify and treat infestations. It offers clear, step-by-step instructions on using the spray for maximum effectiveness, ensuring proper application on surfaces, furnishings, and in affected spaces.

LONG-TERM MOTH PREVENTION - The included eBook also covers proven preventative strategies to stop future infestations. You'll learn essential tips for storing fabrics, cleaning techniques, and identifying risk zones. Troubleshooting advice and maintenance checklists help you maintain a moth-free home with confidence, saving time, protecting valuables, and reducing the need for repeated treatments.

APPROVED FOR PROFESSIONAL AND HOME USE - MothOut Moth Killer Spray is licensed for both amateur and professional use, offering flexible and effective treatment options. Apply as a fine mist for space treatment (1ml per m³) or directly to surfaces for residual control (20ml per m²), assuring coverage of whooping 500m3 of space or 25m2 of surface treatment. Its versatility makes it suitable for homes, offices, museums, and other sensitive environments.

TRUSTED & COMPLIANT UK-MADE FORMULA - MothOut Moth Killer Spray is proudly manufactured in the United Kingdom, ensuring the highest standards of safety, quality, and regulatory compliance. Approved under the Control of Pesticides Regulations and registered with the Health & Safety Executive (HSE No. 10803-GB), it meets all national requirements for both amateur and professional use, giving you complete peace of mind.
description: Three specific types of moths can cause significant damage to clothing, carpets, furniture, rugs, and other fabrics: Common Webbing Moth (Tineola bisselliella), commonly known as the Clothes Moth, Case-Bearing Moth (Tinea pellionella), often referred to as the Carpet Moth and Pale-Backed Moth (Monopis crocicapitella). Each of these moths poses a serious threat to your textiles and furnishings. These moths can settle in nicely in our homes, often going unnoticed as their populations grow. By the time we start to see the damage they cause, the infestation may already be significant. Typically, they make their nests in wardrobes, along the edges of carpets, behind curtains, or under furniture. In some cases, they can even create colonies in loft insulation. MothOut Moth Killer Spray is engineered to eliminate all life stages of fabric-and-carpet moths— larvae, pupae and adults—wherever they hide. Whether you need an instant knockdown of flying moths or a spot treatment on carpets, rugs, wardrobes or upholstery, it delivers rapid eradication and halts the breeding cycle. Fast-Acting & Long-Lasting Kills on Contact: With 0.1% w/w cypermethrin and 0.01% w/w pyriproxyfen plus natural chrysanthemum extract*, adults, larvae and pupae are incapacitated instantly. Up to 12-Week Residual Protection: A single application forms a protective barrier that continues to repel and kill moths for up to three months. Low odour & Non-Staining Water-Based, Odourless Formula: Solvent-free and low-odour, it leaves no unpleasant chemical smell and won’t harm indoor air quality. Fabric-Friendly: Tested safe on wool, silk, carpets, curtains, upholstery and even taxidermy—never alters colour, texture or finish. Easy, Professional-Quality Application Ready-to-Use Spray: Simply apply 25–50 ml per m² on surfaces or use 1–4 ml per m³ as a space spray for whole-room coverage. Versatile Use: Ideal for spot-treating carpet edges, under furniture, inside wardrobes, cupboards, drawers—or as a broad-spectrum ant & crawling insect killer. HSE-Registered & Trusted Approved for use around children and pets when applied as directed. MothOut brings you professional-strength pest control without harsh chemicals—so you can once again enjoy a moth-free home.
